card.name: Just before 'every' in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The spot right after a dose amount (such as mg, mg/kg or m 2) where the word 'every' is expected next, as in 'every 12 hours' or 'every 3 weeks'. It also fires on small words like 'approximately' or 'administered' that come before 'every'.

modes.label: Unit after dose number
modes.description: The unit of a dose (mg, /kg, m 2) comes right before an interval phrase beginning with 'every'.

modes.label: Filler before interval
modes.description: A linking or hedging word or bracket sits between the dose and 'every'.
modes.example: or return to baseline organ function,<< approximately>> every 2 to 6 weeks.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'every' (and 'ogni', '每') as the next word, so a repeat interval follows.
card.plain: It fires when a dose has just been given and the text is about to say how often, with 'every' next.
